title: Unset master token bypasses nonzero device ACL authorization
summary: indigo_change_property accepts omitted request token 0 as the default master token 0, bypassing nonzero device ACL. Confirmed by native XML/JSON regression and unauthorized Server module loading. Next: require nonzero master before master-token equality authorizes.
